author: NovaLikesPvP
body:
Hey, I'm here escalating my appeal that was denied By the Jr mod Sho.
So lemme talk about some points

"If you were aware you shouldn't do that reports, then why you did it"

Yes, I commite an error, and I'm really sorry about that.

"Reports like that can drown other repors that are useful"

An Staff member was already specting The guy I hackusated ( he got banned like a minute later ) so no, I didnt make anyone's job harder.

As I said, I Just this once. 
In my opinion Sho could just msg me or even on chat saying " Nova, please dont abuse of reports " or just a warn, But a KICK when I wasn't doing it again and it was neccesary is ...

I'm sorry, hope you can understand the situation with this.

Regards, Nova.

title: Escalating Appeal - Warn

replies.author: Sho
replies.body:
Hello Nova, 

If you truly feel upset feel free to consult with the seniors. Yes, a warn could have been an option but based on your previous infractions I came to the conclusion that a kick was valid. Guidelines are guidelines but as mods assessing the appropriate punishment for each situation is part of our job too. Please stop appealing as the decision was valid and unfortunately will not change. If you are worried about excessive infractions, I would not worry since it's your in-game behavior that we judge you more on, not solely on your previous infractions. 

Regards,
Sho.

replies.author: Sho
replies.body:
Let me clarify some things. 

It's not just about having previous infractions. Guidelines are guidelines but as staff members assessing the appropriate punishment for each situation is part of our job too. Picture this.

There is a player in chat who is cursing out other players. Usually for swearing towards other users a warn is issued, however depending on WHAT the player is saying and HOW he is acting will determine which punishment is appropriate. In your case, wether I would have given you a warn or a kick makes no difference at this point. 

Kind regards,
Sho.

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Hello Nova.

I'll start this off by saying moderators, while having their punishment guidelines to give them a general idea of what to do when a situation arises, are completely independant in this matter and within certain limits are free to do what they feel most convenient. Also, 

 >"For me, a kick or warn makes a difference."

They both count the same towards excessive infractions, so that's out of the game (also as Sho said it's the behaviour what most matters). The only place where warn or kick could matter is when giving another infraction for breaking the same rule, don't do it and you'll live with it.

 >"the situation didn't need a kick, even a warn may not have been neccessary"

With all due respect, that's not for you to judge. Sho in this case was the one to and decided a kick was the most appropriate thing to give out. That's it, no more rationale behind it.

The punishment is valid, the punishment type was decided by the due staff member and changing it to a warn because you think it's excessive is pointless and neither sides would end up better. Sorry but this appeal is denied.

Regards,
Javi
